ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

- Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
- Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
- Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
- Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
- Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
- Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
- Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

- Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early

- Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
- Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
- Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
- Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
- Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
- Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
- Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
- Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

- Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
- Clinical Days at Goal
- 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
- Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
- Schedule-entry timeliness
- Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
- Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
- Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
- Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
- Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
- Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
- Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements. 
- Skills:
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
- Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
- Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment

Key Competencies

- Leadership & team development
- Delegation, accountability & follow-through
- Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
- Schedule-health oversight & workload management
- Workflow optimization & accuracy
- Efficient decision-making & prioritization
- Cross-functional collaboration

Work Environment

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

About the role
The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
- Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.

What we are looking for - A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
- Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany. 

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Senior Software (Database) Engineer to help build the underlying storage system for our general purpose data platform. The database layer has both OLAP and OTLP capabilities to support classic analytics queries while also serving up freshly stored data. It embraces the separation of compute and storage and is designed to run on multiple cloud providers. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing: 

- Take ownership over and build one or multiple parts of the database: Design, implement, test, and operate ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data formats, storage formats.

- Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant database service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Berlin, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

description:
Mission 

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

Your Tasks 

- Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

- Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

- Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

- IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

- GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

- Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

- Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

Your Profile 

- Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

- Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

- Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

- Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning and AI tooling a strong plus.

- Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

- People who wait to be told what to do.

title: Head of Legal @ AI Chip DeepTech Venture, Dresden / Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. 

About the Venture 

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ. 

About the Role 

This is our first legal hire. 

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction. 

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do 

- Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions. 

- Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently. 

- Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening. 

- Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements. 

- Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability. 

- Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks. 

- Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness. 

- Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too. 

- Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering. 

- Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors. 

- Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget. 

About You 

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side. 

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it. 

- Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation. 

- In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred. 

- Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening. 

- Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate. 

- You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement. 

- Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus. 

- German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken. 

- Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin. 

Why Join 

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors. 

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time. 

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

title: Senior Software Entwickler:in
description:
Wir sind schulz codes: sechs Leute, remote-first, zuhause in Darmstadt. Wir gehen in die Entwicklungsteams von Konzernen und Produktfirmen, damit sie danach schneller und verlässlicher liefern.

Nicht als ein Entwickler mehr im Projekt, sondern als die Leute, die den Output vom ganzen Team hochziehen. Das geht nur, wenn wir richtig gut sind; deshalb suchen wir auch nicht schnell, sondern genau.

Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du gehst mit uns in ein Kundenteam, baust dort mit und bist der Mensch, an dem die technischen Fragen hängenbleiben.

Drei Dinge bekommst du hier, und die meinen wir wörtlich.

- Ownership. Du entscheidest selbst über Architektur mit, sprichst selbst mit den Fachbereichen und stehst dann auch für das, was du entschieden hast. Dauer-Überstunden gehören da ausdrücklich nicht dazu: War eine Woche fordernd, wird die nächste kürzer.

- Wirksamkeit. Du wirst nicht daran gemessen, wie viele Tickets du zumachst, sondern daran, was das Team um dich herum ein halbes Jahr später kann. Und du siehst das auch, dafür sind wir klein genug.

- Und wenn dir was nicht passt, sagst du es und änderst es. Bei uns genauso wie beim Kunden. Das ist hier kein Mut, sondern der Job.

- Das ist eine Senior-Rolle in der Lieferung. Du führst kein Team und wir hängen dir auch keinen Lead-Titel als Karotte vor die Nase. Was du bekommst, ist echte technische Verantwortung, direkter Kundenkontakt und Zeit, richtig gut zu werden.

Aufgaben

- Ganze Features und Epics verantworten, von der Konzeption bis ins Deployment

- Dich schnell in fremden Codebasen zurechtfinden und das Gesamtsystem über Backend, Frontend, Infrastruktur und Schnittstellen hinweg sehen

- Selbst mit den Fachbereichen sprechen, über Architektur entscheiden und dafür geradestehen

- Integrations- und Skalierungsthemen früh auf den Tisch legen, nicht erst kurz vor dem Release

- Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Blocker sichtbar machen, kleine Proof-of-Concepts bauen, wenn eine technische Frage anders nicht zu klären ist

- So schätzen, dass die Unsicherheit mit drinsteht: nicht „fünf Tage", sondern „fünf Tage, Risiko: die API-Spezifikation ist noch unklar"

- Das Team mitziehen: Pairing, Reviews mit Lerneffekt, Onboarding, Standards und Konventionen, die auch nach dir noch halten

Qualifikation

- Rund sechs bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre Backend in TypeScript/Node.js in Produktion

- Architektur selbst verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt: Domain-Driven Design, hexagonale Architektur, modularer Monolith sind Entscheidungen, die du getroffen und dann auch ausgehalten hast

- Entscheidungen auch dann treffen, wenn die Anforderungen noch wackeln

- Saubere Modellierung von Fachdomänen

- Cloud auf Architektur-Ebene, mit bewusster Auswahl der Dienste (AWS, Azure und GCP sind uns gleichwertig)

- React zuverlässig liefern, ohne Frontend-Spezialist zu sein

- Tests schreiben, Reviews vorleben

- Ab Woche eins produktiv in einer fremden Codebase

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, weil du direkt mit deutschen Fachbereichen sprichst

Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Stack 

- Fachlich passende Leute gibt es viele, die Rolle entscheidet sich am Menschen. Drei Dinge müssen bei dir da sein.

- Lernen als innere Notwendigkeit. Nicht „hab ich gelernt, weil das Projekt es gebraucht hat", sondern der echte Drang zu verstehen und vorne mitzugestalten. AI ist dafür gerade das beste Beispiel: sie soll dich verstärken, damit du weiter kommst und mehr baust, aber dein eigenes Verstehen nie ersetzen.

- Der Antrieb, das Arbeiten für alle besser zu machen. Nicht nur den eigenen Fortschritt, sondern Team und Kunde spürbar weiterbringen. Menschen um dich herum heben, echte Verbindung aufbauen. Daraus entsteht Vertrauen, und Vertrauen ist bei uns die Grundlage von allem.

- Ownership, und zwar so wie wir es meinen. Starke Verantwortung für deine Arbeit und ein Stück darüber hinaus, aber ausdrücklich keine Dauer-Überstunden. In der Zeit, die wir uns vornehmen, geben wir unser Bestes, und danach ist Feierabend.

- Dazu unser härtestes Kriterium: du musst bereit sein, dich auf unsere Arbeitsweise einzulassen. Wir sind sehr offen für deine Ideen und ändern gerne Dinge, aber „so kenne ich das, kommt damit klar" funktioniert hier nicht.

Wann wir nicht zusammenpassen 

- Wenn dich vor allem Gehalt und Titel treiben

- Wenn du deine Arbeitsweise durchdrücken willst, statt erstmal zu verstehen

- Wenn dir die Regel wichtiger ist als die Wirkung beim Kunden

- Wenn du AI benutzt, um dich aus dem Verstehen rauszunehmen

Benefits

- Ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden Projekten und modernen Technologien .

- Individuelle Weiterbildung durch Konferenzen, Workshops und interne Wissensaustausche.

- Remote-first

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Mitgestaltungs-Spielraum, dein Wort zählt

- Eine Vielzahl an Benefits

- kurzer Draht zum Geschäftsführer - regelmäßig 1:1, keine Ebene dazwischen

- Ein starkes leistungsorientiertes Team , das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und voneinander lernt.

title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description:
Location : Come and join us either in Berlin or Hamburg! 

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

One of our core goals for 2026 is the complete digitalization of the European taxi market. We are partnering with local fleets to provide them with our advanced Dispatch and Fleet Management software completely for free, helping them cut costs, defend against ride-hailing giants, and thrive.

We are looking for an empathetic, relentless, and hands-on Sales Manager to be the face of this initiative!

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE: 

- Prospect, engage, travel and pitch our Dispatch tool to SMB taxi companies. You will be the primary catalyst for transitioning legacy fleets into modern, connected partners

- Guide fleet owners and head dispatchers through the fear of operational change

- Act as the voice of our partners. You will gather on-the-ground feedback about our software and collaborate directly with our Product and Strategy teams to help "co-build" the ultimate solution

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE: 

- 3-5 years in B2B Business Development, Sales, Account Executive roles. Backgrounds in mobility, logistics, or selling SaaS to SMBs are highly preferred

- Proven track record of managing a B2B pipeline and handling objections. You understand that even when a product is free, you still have to expertly "sell" the time, effort, and operational shift required to adopt it

- Strong communication skills with the ability to build trust and long-term relationships

- Ability to deeply understand how a partner's business operates on a procedural level. You are adept at guiding new partners step-by-step through the transition, ensuring they smoothly adopt new software and daily routines

- You view travel not as a chore, but as an essential part of the job. You are comfortable being on the road for a significant portion of your time (up to 40-50%) to meet partners exactly where they operate

- Fluency in German and English is required due to regular interaction with clients and internal stakeholders

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL: 

- Flexible working arrangements

- LinkedIn Learning

- Sabbatical & special leave policies

- WeRoad partnership

- Birthday, 24th + 31st December off

- Short term EU work policy

- Mobility Credit

- Employee assistance program

Plus more local benefits depending on your work location! 

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION: 

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age. 
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work . 

ABOUT FREENOW: 

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. 

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

title: Account Executive (x/f/m) Außendienst
description:
Ärzt:innen digitalisieren, Praxis für Praxis: Dein Gebiet, Dein Business 

Du machst Neukundengeschäft, weil Dir der Abschluss Spaß macht, nicht das Verwalten von Bestandskund:innen? Du willst nicht ins Büro, sondern raus zu Kund:innen? Dann ist das hier Deine Rolle.

Wir suchen Account Executives im Außendienst für unsere Standorte in ganz Deutschland: Dein Wohnort, Dein Gebiet. 

Das ist der Job, ganz konkret 

- 100 % Neukundenakquise. Du gewinnst Arztpraxen, die heute noch nicht mit Doctolib arbeiten. Keine Bestandskundenbetreuung, keine Renewals, keine Upsell-Quote auf fremden Accounts.

- Echter Field Sales: Die Hälfte Deiner Woche bist Du unterwegs. Du sitzt bei Ärzt:innen im Sprechzimmer, nicht in Videocalls. Rund 40 Kundentermine pro Monat in Deinem Gebiet. Die andere Hälfte Deiner Woche arbeitest Du von daheim oder aus Deinem regionalen Office: Vorbereitung, Telefonakquise, Pipeline-Pflege.

- Dein Gebiet, Deine Verantwortung. Du bekommst ein festes Vertriebsgebiet rund um Deinen Wohnort und steuerst es wie ein eigenes Business: Routenplanung, Priorisierung, Pipeline, Umsatz (MRR) und Kundenbeziehungen. 

- Ziele, die erreichbar sind: 8 bis 10 Abschlüsse pro Monat entsprechen 100 % Zielerreichung. Bei rund 40 Terminen heißt das: etwa jeder vierte Termin endet mit einer Unterschrift. Unser Produkt löst ein echtes Problem, das merkst Du im Gespräch.

- Voller Sales-Cycle in Deiner Hand. Von der Kaltakquise über den Termin bis zum Abschluss. Kein Handover mitten im Prozess.

- Du verkaufst KI, die Ärzt:innen wirklich Zeit zurückgibt: KI-Telefonassistent, KI-Dokumentation, KI-Abrechnungsassistent, digitales Patient:innen-Checkin. Kein Nice-to-have, sondern Entlastung in einem überlasteten System.

Was Du verdienst 

On-Target Earnings: 70.000 bis 80.000 € 

- Fixgehalt: 50.000 bis 58.000 €

- Bonus bei 100 % Ziel: 22.000 €

- Rund 70 % Deines Zielgehalts sind Fixum. Im Außendienst ist ein 50/50-Split üblich, bei uns steht der größere Teil sicher.

- Ungedeckeltes Bonusmodell mit 1,5x bis 2x Overperformance-Kicker. Übererfüllung wird überproportional bezahlt, nicht abgeschnitten. Nach oben ist die Spanne offen.

- Provisionsauszahlung auch an Krankheitstagen.

- Geschützte Ramp-up-Phase von 3 Monaten , damit Du nicht ab Tag 1 auf voller Quote stehst.

Warum jetzt 

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt ist gerade an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt, und wir sind mittendrin: 110.000+ Gesundheitsfachkräfte in Deutschland vertrauen uns, 25 Millionen+ Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform. Der Markt, der noch vor uns liegt, ist größer als alles, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. Genau deshalb bauen wir unsere Field-Sales-Teams jetzt aus.

Das brauchst Du wirklich (Must-haves) 

- Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb. Du hast selbst akquiriert und selbst abgeschlossen.

- Du willst raus zum Kunden. Persönlicher Vertrieb vor Ort ist für Dich kein Kompromiss, sondern der Grund, warum Du diesen Job machst.

- Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher. Alle Kundentermine finden auf Deutsch statt.

Führerschein Klasse B. Brauchst Du täglich. 

Nicht unbedingt nötig: Healthcare-Erfahrung, SaaS-Erfahrung, perfektes Englisch, Studium. Wir bringen Dir Produkt und Markt bei, Vertrieb bringst Du mit.

Was Dich bei uns weiterbringt 

- Doctolib Sales Academy und Buddy-Programm für Deinen Start, plus laufende Trainings zu KI und Produkt

- Klare Karrierepfade: Sales Expert, Mentor:in, Regional Manager:in, dazu laterale Wechsel innerhalb Doctolib

- President's Club mit exklusiven Events und Mentoring, jährlicher Learning Summit in Berlin 

Deine weiteren Benefits 

- Firmenwagen: Ein modernes Fahrzeug, auch privat nutzbar, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung. Tankkarte inklusive.

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 40 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss und Premium-Krankenzusatzversicherung über die Allianz (u. a. Zahnreinigung, Seh- und Augenhilfen)

- Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft 

- DoctoGrowth , unser langfristiges Beteiligungsprogramm für Mitarbeitende

- Parent Care Programm: 1 Monat extra Elternzeit, 4 flexible Rückkehrtage, 5 zusätzliche Kind-krank-Tage pro Kind und Jahr

- Mental-Health- und Coaching-Sessions über moka.care, plus monatliche Homeoffice-Pauschale

Unsere Philosophie 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert. 

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir dich ein, dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung. 

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren! 

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier . 

Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
description:
A BOUT TIDE 

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts: 

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members across UK and India

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- Over 2,800 Tideans globally

- Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

description:
About WPP Production 

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

A Hybrid working model 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

What does a New Business Director (Global ) do at WPP Production? 

The Business Director - Growth & Clients plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production: defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities, deepening our most important client relationships, and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

Reporting into the Global Chief Growth Officer and working closely with the Global Chief Client Officer, this is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win and grow consistently across markets, clients and opportunity types. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will help set the direction of the business and represent growth and clients at a senior level.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities, ensuring that responses are clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across pitches you are leading, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Equally, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, using a deep understanding of their business and objectives to grow relationships and unlock new opportunities.

You will partner with Global Managing Partners on organic and new opportunities and the Global MD of Hex. Hex is the WPP Production Creative Technology and AI Studio specialising in generative AI, agentic AI, gaming, immersive experiences, and robotics. As part of this collaboration, you will come to understand our significant tech and tools partnerships.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth, defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact, high-profile role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth, client satisfaction and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility 

- Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning

- Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across assigned pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value

- Design end-to-end client solutions, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition

- Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency

- Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus

- Partner with the Global Chief Client Officer to grow existing relationships, driving organic growth and cross-selling WPP Production's full breadth of capabilities and services

- Act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, providing strategic insights and guidance that help them achieve their business objectives through the right production strategy

- Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach

- Support financial performance, partnering with Commercial and Finance teams on P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, contribution margins and profit levers across clients and new opportunities

- Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency

- Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality

- Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings and pitch meetings

- Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring collaboration across Media, Creative and Production

- Develop and scale team capability through coaching, mentoring and training, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning

What good looks like (key requirements) 

- Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth, client leadership or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment

- Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won

- Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches

- Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines

- Expert client relationship skills in a multi-stakeholder, matrix environment, with a track record of driving up (or turning around) client satisfaction

- Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level

- Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously

- Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative, technology and production

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges

- A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact

- Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer ( Pre-training ) to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a pre-training research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications 

- Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience

- Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.

- Experience translating methods between areas of application is highly valued

- LLM experience is valuable, but not necessary

- Finance experience is not required

The estimated base salary range for this position is 250,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture 

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading. 

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office. 

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

If we determine that AI assistance was used during any stage of the hiring process, we reserve the right to immediately disqualify your candidacy or rescind any job offers extended.

We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.

Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

About the role 

The Customer Intelligence team are responsible for ensuring our customers take action on Fospha data: turning data into clear recommendations, guiding marketers through budgeting decisions and helping client teams become experts in the Fospha platform.

This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work across live customer accounts from the point that they go live with Fospha, becoming the trusted expert in the domain, our customers and the decisions they are making across their marketing mix. It's a role for someone who wants to learn how to turn data into customer action, in a business where these actions are meaningful and exciting.

- Team : Customer Intelligence

- Level : Graduate - Entry Level

- Location : London, White City

What you’ll be doing: 

- You'll join our Customer Intelligence Team and work across customer accounts, becoming a trusted expert in the insight, model, and data quality that sit behind them

- You'll be responsible for the customer outcomes your team owns — driving action on insight, trust in the model, and confidence in data quality — contributing to customer retention alongside the Account Manager

- You'll build deep expertise in your specialism and use it to solve real customer problems, turning data into clear recommendations, building trust in our methodology, and keeping data accurate and flowing

- You'll be confident and effective in customer-facing moments relevant to your team, building credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- You'll be collaborative, working closely with Account Managers and other specialist teams, feeding customer insight back to Product, and keeping everyone aligned with regular progress updates

In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency

The Centre of Excellence 

- The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Intelligence, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles:

- Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career

- Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate

- Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships

- Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily

- Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management

- Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output

- Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within our Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with your skills and interests

- Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes

What we can offer you 

- Salary: £34k + discretionary 10% bonus

- A workplace pension ~~through Royal London~~, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%

- A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!

- Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps

- 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)

- Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one

- Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more

- Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance

- Paid volunteering days each year

- Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community

- Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

What are we looking for? 

- We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. We’re looking for:

- Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally

- Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel!

- Organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

- Solving problems for customers

- Interest in emerging technologies and excited by the potential and opportunity AI brings

Our Values and Principles 

- You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

- Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be hear

- Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact

- Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure

- Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems

- Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

title: Strategic Account Executive, Global, Corporate
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. 

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us! 

About the Team: 

The Corporate Strategic Sales team focuses on the global growth & expansion of the Top 120 customers headquartered in each region of the world. Working collaboratively within a Pod of other sales professionals, the team is focused on delivering best-in-class sales execution & customer experience through building executive-level relationships and constructing business cases to support Enterprise deployments of AlphaSense.

About the Role: 

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, and accomplished new business sales professional to join our growing Strategic Sales team within the Corporate segment.

The Strategic Account Executive is responsible for driving expansion across some of AlphaSense's largest and highest-potential global accounts, within one of our core Corporate verticals, which span Life Sciences, Tech Media & Telecoms, Energy & Industrials, and Consumer Packaged Goods.

In this role, you will take responsibility for full regions of key global accounts, contributing to long-term account planning, coordinating internal resources, and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You will own defined elements of the account plan and work closely with Regional Account Executives, Sales Development Representatives, Product Specialists, Account Managers, and Customer Success Managers to execute a bottoms-up sales strategy. You'll operate within a Pod structure - a small, tightly-knit team with a shared quota. Your success is the team's success. This role is for someone who thrives in a collaborative, high-accountability environment where individual contribution directly shapes collective outcomes.

This role offers significant ownership, visibility, and impact. You will help define how AlphaSense expands within some of the most influential firms in the world, embedding the platform across research, strategy, and client delivery workflows. This is a unique opportunity to sell an award-winning product experiencing rapid adoption across enterprise and professional services environments.

What You’ll Do: 

- Partner on the strategy and end-to-end sales process across a portfolio of AlphaSense’s most strategic, high-growth potential global account

- Run a high volume of outbound activity, including cold-calling into strategic accounts, to open new conversations, break into new departments, and keeping pipeline consistently full.

- Lead complex enterprise sales cycles while partnering with SDRs and Account Managers to execute long-term account plans.

- Build and cultivate executive-level relationships across strategy, research, competitive intelligence, business development, M&A, and client delivery functions.

- Develop deep expertise in customer use cases, firm-wide workflows, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and AlphaSense’s differentiated value proposition.

- Prospect proactively, initiate senior-level conversations, conduct demos, manage pilots, and close complex, multi-year agreements.

- Partner with SDRs to design and execute targeted, account-based prospecting strategies.

- Forecast accurately and build sufficient pipeline to meet or exceed quota expectations.

- Collaborate closely with Account Management & Customer Success to ensure customer health, long-term value realization, and expansion opportunities across strategic accounts.

Who You Are: 

- An Accomplished Enterprise Sales Professional: You have experience owning complex new business motions within large, global organizations. You bring a strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS sales and understand how to navigate long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

- Strategic and Commercially Sophisticate: You know how to set a vision for a customer, work backwards from desired outcomes, and build thoughtful account strategies that balance near-term wins with long-term expansion.

- A Collaborative Competitor: You're driven to win personally, but you measure success by what the Pod achieves together. You're as invested in your teammates hitting their numbers as you are in your own

- Relentless and Driven: You bring natural tenacity and resilience, with a strong sense of ownership over results and a bias toward action.

- A Compelling Communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex concepts and value propositions to diverse audiences, from practitioners to senior executives. You are a strong storyteller who can articulate both current and future value.

- A True Hunter: You proactively drive pipeline through your own efforts, in addition to leveraging SDR, Marketing, and Account Management support.
Intellectually Curious: You ask insightful questions, uncover underlying business challenges, and seek to deeply understand customer workflows and priorities.
Coachable and Growth-Oriented: You are open to feedback and committed to continuous improvement, leveraging AlphaSense’s robust training and development programs.

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Paris, France
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What Yo u’ ll Do 

- Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API

- Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break

- Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on

- Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for

- Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat

- Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us

- Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have 

- Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)

- Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud

- A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created

- A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone

- The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it

- Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it

- A preference for being corrected over being right

- Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments

- Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process 

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer 

- A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

- A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

- Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

- The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

- Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

- The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

- An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain
